# @smaran/contracts
* `openapi.json` - generated from the FastAPI app (`services/api/scripts/export_openapi.py`).
* `src/schema.d.ts` - generated by `openapi-typescript` (`pnpm generate`). Do not edit.
* `src/domain.ts` - hand-written entity/enum types mirroring `app/models.py` (no secrets). Drift is caught by `services/api/tests/test_contracts.py`.
* `src/wire.ts` - hand-written request/response shapes the briefing declares binding, until all modules publish OpenAPI schemas.
Regenerate everything: `services/api/scripts/gen_contracts.sh` (Integrator: run it WITHOUT `--with-stubs` after merge).
